summary: Preserve generic String.raw behavior including property access and coercion.

target.notes: General String.raw performs observable property access on template.raw and its length/items plus ToString coercions; getters, proxies, and user code can run.

semantics.property_access: Get(template, "raw"), length and indexed elements are observable
semantics.coercion: raw segments and substitutions are ToString-converted left-to-right

caveats: A compiler may add a separate native/helper fast path for syntactic tagged templates whose raw segments are compile-time constants.

tests.name: tagged template common case
tests.expected_behavior: prints the two characters backslash+n between a and b
